message: ヨーグル天狗

name: Synn
message: 「Did I get here a little too early?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Demon Lord, what're you planning to do in a park of all places? Ria told you to rest today, didn't she?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's why I came out to enjoy my day off. If I stay cooped up in my room all day, it'll just wear me out even more.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's that sound?」

name: Synn
message: 「Those are wooden clappers.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I know that much. What's the signal for, though?」

name: Sally
message: 「Kamishibai~, kamishibai~. Delicious Food Squad~♪ Wanna see the kamishibai too Squad~♪」
At the entrance of Miseizaka Park, walking up from the bottom of the residential hill, an elderly man approaches while pushing a heavy-duty bicycle.
Trailing behind him are a crowd of children and cheerful, excited voices. It's a kamishibai picture-story show put on by the Ryuusei Town association to preserve local culture.

name: Sally
message: 「Clack, clack, clack-clack-clack~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so it's Sally's turn today.」
Before starting the kamishibai, the old man makes a round through the neighborhood, briskly clacking the wooden clappers to announce his arrival.
Usually, though, the very first kid who tags along with him gets handed that job.

name: Sally
message: 「It's starting, it's starting~♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Munch, munch. These snacks are so yummy~~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, so you were really just after the snacks?」
Even after the kamishibai ends and the old man leaves, Sally stays in the park munching on snacks.

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm... hmmm? Both!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, the rule is you have to buy snacks from the old man to watch the kamishibai. My recommendation is the five-yen sauce senbei.」

name: Sally
message: 「I never knew kamishibai tasted so good!」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's a limit to how sheltered you can be.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ahan~♪ I'm the Demon World's pure-hearted idol, the sheltered little princess Sally-chan.\s07」

name: Paqy
message: 「You mean a sheltered trash can?」

name: Sally
message: 「Pffft, bleh! I'll share my snacks with Kaichou, but Paqy gets none!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks.」
Sally shares some of the kamishibai snacks with me. Apparently, she got them as a reward for helping out.

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa, that takes me back. Ain't that 'Yoguru'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, you even know its name. You really know your stuff, Paqy.」

name: Sally
message: 「Nom nom, ahhh! Sooo good~~♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Thanks for the food!」

name: Sally
message: 「Sighhh... I'm hungryyyy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Already!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it's something that digests pretty fast, after all.」

name: Sally
message: 「I wanna eat more, I wanna eat more. Hey, hey, Kaicho, when's the kamishibai coming next?」

name: Synn
message: 「It should be making two more stops today.」

name: Synn
message: 「It performs in order at Mihozaka Park, Tsukinoo Park, and the grounds of Asukai Shrine.」

name: Sally
message: 「Roger that! Next is down by the sea, and the one after that is Shio-chin's place, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm taking the Delicious Food Squad and heading out. Come with us too, Kaicho!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Spending a whole day off chasing after a kamishibai sounds fun too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief, someone of Synn-sama's stature acting like a kid. Tagging along just 'cause you wanna clap the wooden blocks, seriously.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? I didn't say anything like that, though?」

name: Sally
message: 「Even though you're always bragging about being the Great Sage, you actually wanna go clack-clack!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah! Sh-Shut up, you washboard!」

name: Sally
message: 「Clack, clack, clack-clack-claaack♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「I told you to shut up!!」
And so, I meet up with the Delicious Food Squad and head straight for Tsukinoo Park.
Come to think of it, everyone here is a resident of Grand Palace Sakura. Spending a day off like this isn't bad at all.
